_comment: Pass 6 (2026-09-19): the NIS-scored L5 noise sweep the gap analysis's K9 asks for. Merged into manifest.json by launch_pass6.py only after the pass-5 supervisor has exited, because these stage types were added to supervisor.py after it started. Sites in priority order: the three Phase 0 corpus sites first (their NIS baselines are already published), then three more placements; the chain of depends_on makes a budget cut drop whole sites from the end. Nine configs per site: baseline; each of process_noise_pos, process_noise_vel, measurement_noise at 0.25x and 4x its default; all three at 0.25x (a control: scaling Q and R together leaves the gain unchanged, so mean NIS should rise by about 4x if the metric is behaving); and measurement_noise 4x with process_noise_pos 0.25x, the heavier-smoothing direction the preliminary L5 pass favoured on the circular metric. Scoring 200 s after the 70 s warm-up (270 s of the 300 s first segment): the 20 s smoke test at Columbus produced only 43 and 41 accepted observations in the 2 and 5 m/s bands, so 120 s risked leaving the moving bands under the analyzer's count floor.
